records.source_statement: An intervening friend is said to mediate reconciliation.
Without mediator, Sun and Venus are used as supplementary significators in return inquiry.
Sun above earth and Venus in favourable sextile or trine to ascendant is read as easy return.
Sun below earth and Venus above with good aspect gives a slower return and neighbours' notice.
Waxing Moon in good aspect to ascendant is said to show return after solicitation.
